title: Boy with Glowing Brain
description: A young boy with wet brown hair and blue eyes smiles while submerged underwater, his right hand touching a large, translucent, glowing pink-purple brain floating above his head. The surreal underwater scene includes a sea turtle, colorful tropical fish, vibrant coral reefs in purple, orange and pink, all set against swirling red and orange water.
